note: getProcessor returns the lambda `(externs, root) -> new RewriteCallerCodeLocation(compiler).process(externs, root)`. CompilerTestCase calls it as `getProcessor(compiler).process(externsRoot, mainRoot)` (CompilerTestCase.java line 1266), so the pass is constructed and run back to back either way; the constructor only stores compiler, compiler.createAstFactory() and a new LinkedHashMap, none of which can differ between the two points. A direct {"new"} is therefore equivalent and keeps the pass visible to --mutate-noop. setUp is not overridden; the per-test enableTypeCheck/enableParseTypeInfo are in harness.fields. The class declares no fields.
